player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mwari {player_id} mumhango wa Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; unonyara chete kadhi ya mwari wekutanga.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila mwaka, {max_rounds} mwaka(s) wose.
- Mwero unowanzika: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni integer chete chisina kudzika kwa chip yako yose.)
- Kadhi yekutanga inowana pot kuna kuzvimbisa.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pesa moja chete action yenziwa kuboka, kubva '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', kana '[fold]'.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Shandisa [bet X] kuvhura; hapana bheji rekusimudza.
invalid_move.insufficient: Chips dzisina kukwana nokuda kwechiito ichocho.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: zvose {card}. Pot split  mumwe nomumwe anogamuchira {split}.
